external_preimport_trust_root: System sha256 tooling verifies the frozen lock and launcher before the launcher runs. Before Python import the launcher hashes every candidate-lock artifact including the concrete pre-capture schedule authority and both comparison schemas. Capture consumes that authority before grammar validation, records its hash in the execution lock, and atomically creates an O_EXCL result lock containing exact artifact paths/hashes, execution-lock hash, and all eight terminal durable-effect receipts. After both captures, bind atomically O_EXCL-creates the post-capture comparison-result binding and prints exactly its SHA-256; same-path replay exits 64 without changing those bytes. Validation consumes the captured binding SHA-256 and externally supplied result-lock SHA-256 values before Python imports either side. Each side resolves its supplied immutable authority lock and source manifest independently, and public record/pair validation receives that resolved lock without a workspace-current fallback. Duplicate, omission, crossed, swapped, stale, same-id, mixed-fixture/environment/schedule, warmup/order, persistence-failed, absent, result-lock receipt mismatch, and replay-duplicate evidence rejects. Python resolution is not a trust root.
